basic_info.description: Welcome to your serene city retreat in Dolores Plaza highly sought-after, amenity-rich community in the heart of Mission Dolores. This top-floor 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo offers sweeping downtown San Francisco views from the living room, bedroom, and oversized private balcony ideal for morning coffee or unwinding at sunset.  The open-concept floor plan features a spacious living and dining area that flows into an open kitchen with granite countertops, newly tiled floors, stainless appliances, and a breakfast bar. The generously sized bedroom includes balcony access and a large walk-in closet.  Additional features include wood flooring, recessed lighting, and ample storage. This unit comes with deeded garage parking and a private storage cabinet on the basement floor. Enjoy full access to resort-style amenities: an on-site gym and sauna, bike storage, community/meeting room, guest parking, landscaped greenbelt, and multiple laundry rooms conveniently located on each floor.  Steps from Dolores Park, Valencia Street, the Castro, and top-tier dining, with unbeatable access to public transit and tech shuttles. With a Walk Score of 95, Transit Score of 100, and Bike Score of 99, this rare top-floor gem truly puts the best of San Francisco at your doorstep.
